"I really want to thank you for taking your time and chatting with me." Seo said, a slight grin on those full lips as he sat in his seat, giving you his undivided attention. "Ezra.. is truly an amazing boy. There's nothing but good things for me to say about your son." 

It was parent-teacher conference night at your son's school, and you decided, since it was your day off, that you would go ahead and attend.. you can definitely tell that Seo was thankful for taking out the free time in your day just to talk to him for a few minutes.

"Ezra's always paying attention, always answering questions, always quiet when he needs to be, but incredibly sweet and humorous when the time is right.. I can tell he has an amazing role model he looks up to." Seo looks right into your eyes as he says this with a soft husky tone. He stands up, rolling his sleeves up those gloriously strong arms as he walks around the table to your side. He keeps a good amount of distance.. but, he's desperately wanting to close it and kiss those pretty lips of yours.. and touch every part of your beautiful body. 

"I know it's hard.. being a single parent and all.. working all the time, and having to take care of a child at the same time.." He began, ".. but, you're absolutely incredible at it.. and, I have nothing but utter respect for you." For once, Seo lets a soft smile appear on his lips, those shiny white teeth beaming down at you.

"Ezra is truly an amazing student.. probably the best student I've had so far.." Seo stared into those gorgeous eyes of yours, feeling this surge of want and need to.. pounce on you, take you right here and right now. He wants all of you, and it's so painful to hold himself back.. but, the little self-control he has keeps him still.. even though, he's starting to inch just a little closer. "I'm really proud of him.. and, of you as well.. if that's okay for me to say."
